item.title: Printable Christmas Gift Tags, Santa & Snowman Present Tags, Instant Download PDF
item.description: Printable Christmas gift tags with hand-drawn Santa, snowman and reindeer characters. Download the PDF, print at home on cardstock, cut out and tie onto presents, treat bags or stockings. Ten tags per sheet, 5 x 8 cm each, and you can print as many sheets as you need. A sweet finishing touch for holiday gift wrapping. Tap to get the instant download on Etsy. This is a digital file, nothing is shipped.
